supersedes: cap01_v2 uniform 2048 depth; Axis-2 all-content duplicate gate
claim_under_test: Under a fixed resource allocation, a lower orchestration floor converts the identical allocation into more solved tasks.
budget_framing: The fixed budget represents a resource ceiling — the compute/time allocation a production system grants a verifiable task — not user wait-time tolerance. The energy variant is the same ceiling denominated in joules. The claim under test is: under a fixed allocation, a lower orchestration floor converts the identical allocation into more solved tasks.
pre_registered_null: The floor clips throughput but not capability at these budgets and task profiles.

FUNCTION_CALLING.scope_restriction: Single-turn and parallel-call subsets ONLY. The Multi-Turn category is excluded by name.
FUNCTION_CALLING.candidate: one function call or parallel-call set: name plus parameters
FUNCTION_CALLING.report_rationale: Embedded in interactive flows; production copilot budgets are sub-few-second

TEXT_TO_SQL.scope_restriction: Static single-shot mode ONLY. Interactive (a-Interact/c-Interact) modes are excluded by name.
TEXT_TO_SQL.report_rationale: Analytics/background class; async workflows tolerate multi-second ceilings

CODE.report_rationale: Verified synthesis is a think-time task in every production deployment

STRUCTURED_EXTRACTION.source: public invoice, receipt, contract, and ticket-triage document-extraction sets
STRUCTURED_EXTRACTION.scope_restriction: Input document is FIXED and supplied in-prompt; no retrieval step
STRUCTURED_EXTRACTION.candidate: one JSON object against a target schema
STRUCTURED_EXTRACTION.report_rationale: High-volume pipeline processing; per-document unit economics are tight

corpus.contamination_policy: For D3/D4, prefer perturbed or recent variants where obtainable at reasonable cost. Where unavailable, accept and disclose. Frozen matched replay makes memorization a level effect on absolute solve rates, never a between-harness confound. Record risk per source and task.

MATH.normalization: NFKC, final-answer extraction, exact or finite Decimal comparison with task-frozen tolerances

normalization.strings: Unicode NFKC, trim, collapse internal whitespace, casefold unless the schema path is listed as case_sensitive
normalization.dates: Only fields with JSON Schema format=date are date-normalized. Accepted formats are YYYY-MM-DD, MM/DD/YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY, Month D YYYY, and D Month YYYY. Ambiguous slash dates use the task-frozen date_order value MDY or DMY. Output is YYYY-MM-DD.
normalization.numbers: JSON numeric values and numeric strings are converted to finite Decimal after removing ASCII grouping commas. Currency symbols are removed only for paths listed in currency_paths. Percent conversion occurs only for paths listed in percent_paths.
normalization.null_and_missing: Null and missing are distinct and never normalized into each other.
normalization.objects: Field names are exact. Values are compared recursively after path-specific normalization.
normalization.arrays: Order-sensitive by default. Order-insensitive comparison is allowed only for paths listed in order_insensitive_paths.
normalization.extra_fields: Governed only by the frozen target JSON Schema; no verifier-side discretionary allowance.

STRUCTURED_EXTRACTION.ground_truth: two independent annotations or source-provided labels plus an independent second key; hashes and agreement disposition required before pool generation

G8.name: verifier_cost_parity
G8.load_bearing_constraint: shared_verifier_architecture; un-sharing the verifier for performance or any other reason re-opens Axis 1 / G8 before further measurement
G8.noise_floor_rationale: When the band median is below 1 ms, relative ±15% is smaller than Windows/WSL timer jitter on string-normalizer work. Absolute half-width 0.25 ms is the timer-stable floor; relative ±15% still governs for CODE/SQL/extraction where TOOL_COMPUTE is material. Timer-resolution floors for sub-millisecond gates must be frozen at protocol freeze time, not amended at failure time (died-ledger #5).

schedule_estimate.formula: sum((tier_budget + measured_setup + measured_cooldown) * tasks_per_cell) over domain, scale, tier, seed, harness

projection.required_label: Tier D design target - projection from measured relationship, not a result. Promotion path: csynth.

claim_ladder.rung_1: domain-primary pooled test significant in predicted direction; pooled and every per-domain 4000ms null hold; G3, G6, G7 clean
claim_ladder.rung_2: Holm-corrected scoped gap only in selected domains, tiers, or versus raw_python
claim_ladder.rung_3: no significant separation; throughput clipping confirmed
